hero.title: Vault Authoring and Operations Professional
hero.description: Current Exam Description: Demonstrate your advanced, production-level Vault expertise in an intensive, lab-based exam. Feel free to update the description if there's a new one

announcement.text: Learn from certified instructors on how to boost your enterprise adoption of HashiCorp

whoShouldTakeExam.title: Who should take this exam
whoShouldTakeExam.description: You should take the Vault Authoring and Operations Professional exam if you have advanced production-level Vault expertise in both configuration authoring and Vault workflows. You will need to demonstrate your professional-level skills implementing and authoring Vault modules, developing dynamic HCL configuration, and establishing scalable, collaborative workflows.

details.name: Price
details.value: $70.50 USD, plus locally applicable taxes and fees. Free retake not included.

details.name: Keyboard
details.value: US QWERTY only (contact certifications@hashicorp.com for other languages or layouts)

prerequisites.title: Prerequisites
prereqs: Vault Associate certification (strongly recommend, or equivalent experience required)

prerequisites.bottomDescription: While professional experience is recommended, you can also prepare by practicing the exam objectives in a personal demo setup.

renewCertifications.title: Renew Your Certification
renewCertifications.description: Understand your recertification options. Start by finding the scenario that applies to you and then evaluate your options. Know which exam version you passed by the 3-digit code on your credentials (badge and certificate).
